purpose: Teach: 的中/村長/手抜き/投じ/成し遂げ/はかっ/事由/斡旋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場予測が的中する精度を上げろ
lines.en: Raise the accuracy of our market forecasts. I want more of them hitting the mark.
lines.style: Low level command, no wasted syllables, full weight landing on the verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元の村長との会合を設定します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll set up a meeting with the local village mayor.
lines.style: Prompt crisp acknowledgment, businesslike pace, a faint eager-to-please edge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質管理に手抜きを許すな
lines.en: And no corner-cutting in quality control. None.
lines.style: Quiet steel, slower and firmer, a beat of silence doing the threatening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社運を投じてプロジェクトを進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're staking the company's future on this project — I'll keep it moving.
lines.style: Steady reporting tone, a touch of gravity on the stakes, controlled exhale after.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、目標を成し遂げた社員を表彰しろ
lines.en: See that the staff who achieved their targets are properly recognized.
lines.style: Measured directive, the tone easing one shade warmer on the recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費をはかった上で計画を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll weigh the costs first, then move the plan forward.
lines.style: Methodical, ticking through the steps aloud, an even careful rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約の事由を明文化しろ
lines.en: Put the grounds of the contract down in writing. Explicitly.
lines.style: Clipped precision, each word placed like a stamp, no lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引先の斡旋を受けました
lines.en: Yes, sir. And one more thing — we've been referred a new client.
lines.style: Closing report brightening slightly, quiet satisfaction tucked into the good news.
